stage3.reason: Stage3 does not yet have a final all-gates PASS manifest on main. S3G2 has a deterministic clean-integration final PASS, but S3G1J and S3G4 remain final-gate blockers.

freshness.reason: The frozen market/lifecycle/corporate-action base is older than the hard calendar-day stale threshold and Stage3 financial coverage is not finalized on main.

reproducibility.reason: Full project reproducibility cannot pass until S3G1J and S3G4 final datasets exist and the complete Stage3 freeze is rebuilt deterministically.

notes: Stage-local fields such as data/stage2_final/manifest.json:alpha_training_allowed mean only that Stage2 no longer blocks downstream work; they are not project-level authorization.
Any missing, stale, contradictory, or unverifiable readiness evidence is fail-closed.
